remarks:
Comfort and class, this move-in ready 2 bedroom Townhouse has an extensive list of renovations bringing a competitive standard of quality for it's somewhat smaller stature. Some notable updates include new multi-zone air conditioning, new appliances included, new exterior door, new sliding glass door to dining room, and entire first level flooring replaced with Bamboo to name a few. New LVP flooring in bathrooms and kitchen, new vanities and lighting in both bathrooms. All carpeting and interior doors have been replaced. Recently updated 3-season room includes new sliding glass doors x 3, insulation, LVP flooring and added electric. 
Private driveway plus 2 additional assigned parking spaces in shared front lot. In addition to the exterior features is a new vinyl privacy fence to the backyard, a new 21ft x 21ft concrete patio with underground drainage built in, recently repainted 12ft x 8ft shed, and stained exterior siding of home. A 20ft x 12ft attached garage, multiple closets throughout and a storage room opposite exterior entrance prove storage capacity is abundant. The vaulted ceiling brings space to the main living area, and the entry foyer brings a degree of separation coming in the main door. Schedule a showing at your earliest convenience.
Currently under contract with an "escape clause", open to other offers.
